entityTypes.name: Project
entityTypes.description: A scoped engagement delivered for a client.

entityTypes.name: Deliverable
entityTypes.description: A specific output or artifact within a project.

entityTypes.name: Milestone
entityTypes.description: A time-bound checkpoint within a project.

entityTypes.name: Invoice
entityTypes.description: A billing document issued to a client.

entityTypes.name: Risk
entityTypes.description: A potential issue affecting delivery or revenue.

entityTypes.name: Lead
entityTypes.description: A prospective client in the sales pipeline.

entityTypes.name: Proposal
entityTypes.description: A formal commercial proposal to a prospect.

entityTypes.name: Resource
entityTypes.description: A person or capacity unit assigned to work.

entityTypes.name: ChangeRequest
entityTypes.description: A formal scope, timeline, or budget change request.

policies.name: Block unauthorised external writes
policies.description: Any EXTERNAL_API_CALL must pass L3 approval.

policies.name: Notify on critical risk
policies.description: CRITICAL risks must trigger an internal notification.

policies.name: Require approval for large invoices
policies.description: Invoices above ₹5 lakh require L3 approval.

policies.name: Block record deletion
policies.description: WAANDA may never delete records — only archive.

policies.name: Notify on low-quality lead advance
policies.description: Alert if a lead with score < 30 advances to PROPOSAL.

delivery.name: Project Kick-off
delivery.description: Triggered on new project creation. Briefs WAANDA, sets goals, creates milestone plan, assigns risks, notifies client.

delivery.name: Milestone Review
delivery.description: 7-day pre-milestone health check. Routes to internal flag or client update based on project status.

delivery.name: Risk Escalation
delivery.description: CRITICAL risk triggers blast-radius assessment, L3 approval, then client notification.

delivery.name: Project Closure
delivery.description: All deliverables complete. Quality check → client sign-off → COIG checkpoint → lessons learned.

finance.name: Invoice Approval
finance.description: Invoice created above threshold. WAANDA validates → L3 approval → status update.

finance.name: Collections Escalation
finance.description: 14-day overdue invoice. WAANDA drafts collections message → L2 approval → send.

finance.name: Budget Variance Alert
finance.description: Weekly actuals vs plan scan. Routes by severity: log / internal alert / decision proposal.

sales.name: Lead Qualification Flow
sales.description: New lead. DEAL_COACH scores → proposes accept/nurture/decline → creates tasks on qualification.

sales.name: Proposal Follow-up
sales.description: 5-day no-response trigger. DEAL_COACH drafts follow-up — auto-send < ₹5L, L2 review ≥ ₹5L.
